name: proto-upstream-copy-in-an-include-directory
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the directory a copy of an upstream schema is kept below is an import root ahead of the target root, as the include path the build passes to protoc: the copy takes its upstream import path, an import of that path reads it in place of protoc's own file, and it is live under schema-vendored while the field typed by it is decided by its bindings, with no note.
